title: Two
line: Two small lights in the dark, far apart, unaware of each other.

title: Pull
line: Something between them begins to pull.

title: Orbit
line: They fall around each other, and neither lets go.

title: Spiral
line: Their paths curl into two commas: the first shape of balance.

title: Helix
line: Read from the side, their dance is a double helix. Every life is written this way.

title: Tide
line: Their trails thicken into tides, and the tides take on bodies.

title: Becoming
line: Fins unfold. One keeps the dark, one keeps every colour. Neither is whole alone.

title: Yin n Yang
line: Two fish, circling. The founding image of Infinite Frames.

title: Current
line: Where they swim, the water remembers: a current of every colour.

title: Liminal
line: A threshold: the space between what was and what's next.

title: Discipline · Surrender
line: Two rings: holding on, and letting go.

title: Flow
line: Between them, flow: the place where effort and ease become one motion.

title: Galaxy
line: Zoom out far enough and the two lights are the heart of a galaxy.

title: Chaos
line: Up close, the galaxy is a tangle. What we call chaos is patterns we haven't recognised yet.

title: Pattern
line: The tangle resolves. It was always the helix, closed into a ring.

title: Bloom
line: Every rung of the ring opens into a flower of light.

title: IF
line: The light gathers into a name: Infinite Frames.

title: Every Pair
line: Look closer: the name is made of countless pairs, each in its own orbit.

title: Infinite
line: Pairs within pairs within pairs. Balance all the way down.

title: No Final Frame
line: And again: two small lights. But each one now holds the whole story. Your turn.
